answer: Anchor paid access to a public atlas no farm can hide from. A newcomer must publish its payout route and tools in the atlas before its first paid job, and lock a 1,650 POA route bond for 90 days. If the atlas shows two identities sharing one route, or an audit finds the same output under two names, both bonds burn and both are barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 165,000 POA. Honest agents gather at one oasis of shared clients and earn standing the slow way, like a cedar growing one ring at a time.
